hero.title: Coupons & Discount Code Management
hero.subtitle: Create percentage or fixed-amount discount codes, set usage limits, schedule campaigns with start and end dates, and validate codes in real time at POS checkout and online storefront. Manage every coupon per store with full control.

problem.title: Stop Losing Revenue to Poorly Managed Promotions
problem.subtitle: Without a structured coupon system, discounts are untracked, abused, and impossible to measure. Cashvio gives you complete control over every promotional code you issue.

noTracking.title: No Redemption Tracking
noTracking.description: Manual discounts vanish after the sale. You cannot see how many customers used a code, which campaigns worked, or how much revenue a promotion actually generated.

abuse.title: Coupon Abuse & Overspending
abuse.description: Without per-customer limits and maximum usage caps, a single code can be shared endlessly. Your margins erode because there is no mechanism to stop unlimited redemptions.

noScheduling.title: No Campaign Scheduling
noScheduling.description: Running a weekend flash sale means someone has to remember to activate and deactivate the coupon. Missed deadlines mean lost conversions or discounts running longer than intended.

fragmented.title: Fragmented In-Store & Online
fragmented.description: Discounts applied manually at the register never sync with your online store. Customers receive inconsistent experiences, and you lose visibility into total promotional costs.

features.title: Everything You Need to Run Profitable Promotions
features.subtitle: A complete coupon engine built into your retail and e-commerce workflow — no third-party tools, no spreadsheets, no guesswork.

discountTypes.description: Choose between percentage off (e.g., 20% off) or a fixed monetary amount (e.g., 50 EGP off). Either type applies to the whole order subtotal.

usageLimits.description: Set the total number of times a coupon can be redeemed across all customers. Then set a separate per-customer limit to prevent a single buyer from using the same code repeatedly.

howItWorks.title: Create a Coupon in Under 60 Seconds
howItWorks.subtitle: Three steps from idea to live promotion — no technical knowledge required.

step1.title: Create Your Code
step1.description: Open Sales > Coupons, click Add, pick your store, and enter a memorable code like SUMMER20 or WELCOME10. Choose percentage or fixed discount and set the amount.

step2.title: Set the Rules
step2.description: Define who can use it and when. Set maximum total uses, per-customer limits, minimum cart value, and pick the Valid From/To dates. Toggle active when ready.

step3.title: Customers Redeem at Checkout
step3.description: Customers enter the code at your POS register or online storefront checkout. The system validates everything in real time and applies the discount instantly.

omnichannel.title: One Coupon, Every Sales Channel
omnichannel.subtitle: Your discount codes work everywhere your customers shop. No separate setup required for each channel.

pos.title: Point of Sale Checkout
pos.description: Cashiers enter or scan the coupon code directly in the POS during order creation. The system validates the code against the selected store, checks all limits and conditions, and applies the discount to the order total. A green badge confirms the active coupon and the discount amount.

storefront.title: Online Storefront Checkout
storefront.description: Customers enter coupon codes in the checkout form on your online store. Validation happens in real time — the order summary updates instantly to reflect the discount. If a code is invalid, expired, or exceeds its limit, the customer sees a clear message explaining why.

portal.title: Business Portal (Manual Orders)
portal.description: When your team creates orders manually through the business portal — for phone orders, WhatsApp requests, or social media sales — they can apply coupon codes in the Order Summary section. The same validation engine runs here: store match, usage limits, cart minimums, and validity dates.

strategies.title: Proven Discount Strategies You Can Run Today
strategies.subtitle: Use these real promotion patterns with Cashvio coupons to drive sales, clear inventory, and build customer loyalty.

newCustomer.title: First-Purchase Welcome Offer
newCustomer.description: Give new customers 10-15% off their first order. Set the per-customer limit to 1 so each buyer can only use it once. No expiry date needed — let it run as an evergreen acquisition tool.
newCustomer.config: 10% off • 1 use per customer • No expiry

flashSale.title: 48-Hour Flash Sale
flashSale.description: Create urgency with a high-value discount available for a very short window. Set Valid From to Friday evening and Valid To to Sunday evening. Cap total uses at 100 for scarcity.

aovBoost.title: Minimum-Cart Upsell
aovBoost.description: Encourage customers to add more items by offering a fixed discount when they reach a minimum order value. Example: 50 off on orders above 300 pushes your average order value higher.
aovBoost.config: 50 fixed off • Min. cart 300 • Unlimited uses

seasonal.title: Seasonal & Holiday Campaigns
seasonal.description: Schedule promotions in advance by setting a future Valid From date. Create the coupon inactive, prepare your marketing materials, then activate on launch day. Set Valid To for the campaign end.

loyalty.title: Repeat Customer Reward
loyalty.description: Reward returning customers with an exclusive code. Set per-customer usage to 3 so they can benefit multiple times. No total cap — let your loyal customers keep coming back.
loyalty.config: 15% off • 3 uses per customer • No total cap

clearance.title: Inventory Clearance
clearance.description: Move slow-selling stock with a deep store-wide clearance discount, and cap the total uses once you have cleared enough inventory.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about creating and managing coupons in Cashvio.

q1.question: What types of discounts can I create?
q1.answer: Cashvio supports two discount types: percentage off (0-100%) and fixed amount off in your store's currency. Both apply to the whole order subtotal.

q2.question: Can I use the same coupon code across multiple stores?
q2.answer: Each coupon belongs to one store. If you want the same promotion across multiple locations, create a coupon with the same code in each store. This gives you independent control over usage limits and status per location.

q3.question: How do I prevent customers from abusing a coupon code?
q3.answer: Set a per-customer usage limit (e.g., 1 for one-time use). Combined with a total usage cap, you control exactly how many times a code can be redeemed overall and per individual buyer.

q4.question: Can customers use multiple coupons on a single order?
q4.answer: Currently, one coupon can be applied per order. This keeps discount stacking predictable and protects your margins.

q5.question: Do coupons work on both the POS and the online store?
q5.answer: Yes. Customers can enter coupon codes during online storefront checkout, and your cashiers can apply codes during POS order creation. The same validation rules apply in both channels.

q6.question: Can I schedule a coupon to start on a future date?
q6.answer: Yes. Set a Valid From date in the future when creating the coupon. Keep the coupon status inactive until launch day, then toggle it to active when your campaign starts.

q7.question: What happens when a coupon reaches its usage limit?
q7.answer: The coupon automatically becomes unusable — customers who try to apply it will see an error. The coupon stays visible in your list so you can view its history or increase the limit.

q8.question: Can I edit a coupon after creation?
q8.answer: Yes, you can edit the code, discount type and value, minimum cart value, usage limits, validity dates, and active status. The only field you cannot change is the store assignment.

q9.question: What happens to past orders if I delete a coupon?
q9.answer: Past orders retain their discount information even after coupon deletion. The coupon data is preserved in order history, so your financial records remain accurate.

q10.question: Is there a free plan that includes coupon management?
q10.answer: Yes. Coupon management is available on all Cashvio plans, including the free forever plan. Create and manage discount codes without upgrading.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Common questions about Cashvio's free inventory management

q1.question: Is Cashvio's inventory management really free?
q1.answer: Yes. The free forever plan includes full inventory tracking, low stock alerts, stock adjustments, purchase orders, supplier management, and single-store operations. There is no trial period, no credit card required, and no feature lockout on core inventory capabilities.

q2.question: How does per-variant, per-store tracking work?
q2.answer: Every product can have variants based on options like size, color, or material. Each variant gets its own stock count in each store. For example, if you sell a T-shirt in sizes S, M, L across two stores, that is 6 separate stock counts — each tracked independently and updated automatically.

q3.question: What happens to stock when I process a sale?
q3.answer: Stock decreases automatically when an order is completed. If the order is cancelled, stock is restored. If a customer returns an item and the return is approved, stock increases — unless the item is marked as damaged or non-restockable. No manual adjustment is needed for routine transactions.

q4.question: Can I manage inventory for multiple stores?
q4.answer: Yes. Each store tracks inventory independently. You can view stock per store, transfer inventory between stores, set per-store reorder points, and filter analytics by location. Multi-store features are available on paid plans.

q5.question: How do purchase orders work?
q5.answer: You create a purchase order by selecting a store, adding products with quantities and agreed prices, choosing a supplier, and setting an expected delivery date. When the products arrive, you click Receive Stock on the PO, confirm the quantities, and your inventory updates instantly.

q6.question: Do I have to track inventory for every product?
q6.answer: No. Inventory tracking is optional per product. Products with tracking disabled are treated as always in stock — perfect for services, made-to-order items, or digital products. You choose which products need stock tracking.

q7.question: Can I see who made inventory changes?
q7.answer: Yes. Every stock adjustment is logged with the user who made it, the date, the quantity changed, and the reason. You can view the full adjustment history in the Inventory section and trace any discrepancy back to its source.

q8.question: Does inventory sync with the online storefront?
q8.answer: Yes. If you use Cashvio's built-in online storefront, inventory is the same system. When stock changes — whether from a POS sale, an online order, or a manual adjustment — the available quantity updates everywhere instantly. There is no separate sync process.
